exposure: soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1 (sFlt-1) serum levels
cohort: Sixty gravid women were enrolled, consisting of 36 women with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders and 24 women without PAS disorders, for comparison of third-trimester sFlt-1 serum levels.
finding: Third-trimester sFlt-1 serum level was not independently associated with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders or postpartum blood loss after adjusting for confounding factors.
